LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided writing (1 Lesson) German Orthography Rules By the end of the
Topic 3.2: Guided writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided writing, part of Writing 3.1 Guided writing (1 Lesson) German Orthography Rules By the end of the in Grade 5 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: Why are rules important in writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. complete (Steckbrief: Vorname, Familienname, Spitzname) information on family members,

2. fill a puzzle on nuclear family members,

3. word search on nuclear family,

4. fill the missing letters/words in a text,

5. sketch a portrait of nuclear family tree, write short descriptions and present to peers.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. complete (Steckbrief: Vorname, Familienname, Spitzname) information on family members,
2. fill a puzzle on nuclear family members,
3. word search on nuclear family,
4. fill the missing letters/words in a text,
5. sketch a portrait of nuclear family tree, write short descriptions and present to peers.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Communication and collaboration: Learner develops the skills of communicating effectively as they sketch a portrait of

nuclear family tree, write short descriptions and present to peers.
